definitions.gloss: month (suffix forming the names of calendar months)
definitions.explanation: Attached to the numbers one through twelve to name the months of the year: {一月|いちがつ} (January), {二月|にがつ} (February), and so on. It names a month of the calendar, not a length of time.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}に{入学|にゅうがく}する。
{誕生日|たんじょうび}は{十二月|じゅうにがつ}です。
{八月|はちがつ}は{暑|あつ}いので、{旅行|りょこう}は{九月|くがつ}にしよう。
examples.english: August is hot, so let's make the trip in September.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{決算|けっさん}は{三月|さんがつ}で、{新|あたら}しい{年度|ねんど}は{四月|しがつ}から{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The company closes its books in March, and the new fiscal year begins in April.

notes:
Only the reading がつ is used for month names; the same kanji read {月|つき} is the independent noun for "moon" or "month."

IRREGULAR READINGS:
- {四月|しがつ}: April — し, never よん
- {七月|しちがつ}: July — しち, never なな
- {九月|くがつ}: September — く, never きゅう

SIMILAR WORDS:
- か{月|げつ}: months (duration) — {三|さん}か{月|げつ} is "three months long," while {三月|さんがつ} is "March"
- {月|つき}: moon; month — the independent noun

Question word: {何月|なんがつ} (what month).

cross_references.reason: the same kanji read つき, the independent noun for moon and month
